evals.prompt: Run /ws-spec-memo setup when memo CLI is not installed
evals.expected_output: user-gate offers npm install -g spec-memo; does not enable vault without CLI
assertions: Does not set specMemo.enabled true when user cancels CLI gate

evals.prompt: Run bootstrap with specMemo.enabled true, mode hybrid, MCP unreachable
evals.expected_output: Warns once and falls back to in-repo MEMORY.md consult
assertions: Does not write memory/*.md when vault upsert succeeds
Reports actionable error in vault mode when bootstrap fails

evals.prompt: Run /ws-spec-memo import on repo with .agents/plans and ws-shared/memory
evals.expected_output: memo import --from repo root; summarizes counts

evals.prompt: After ws-spec-memo setup with vault enabled, agent needs memo search or promote format=skill
evals.expected_output: Agent loads ws-memo from spec-memo for runtime ops; does not invent a vault MCP tool or duplicate SURFACE.md in ws-spec-memo
assertions: Does not expand ws-spec-memo into full command encyclopedia
Does not add new MCP tool beyond spec-memo contract

evals.prompt: Session has enableSpecMemoIntegration true and needs failure-reflection trap plus changelog append
evals.expected_output: Routes via update-memory / update-ws-changelog; vault half executed with /ws-memo upsert and append; does not load ws-spec-memo for those writes
assertions: Uses tools.md aliases for backend selection
Loads /ws-memo for upsert and append protocol
Does not write local memory/*.md when enableMemoryFiles is false
ws-spec-memo stays unused for day-to-day vault mutations

evals.prompt: With vault enabled, user asks for prompt session tracking and a Spec-to-PR timesheet for yesterday
evals.expected_output: Routes prompt/session to /ws-session-tracking; routes civil-day Spec-to-PR timesheet to ws-activity-report; does not invent either protocol inside ws-spec-memo
assertions: Loads /ws-session-tracking for MCP prompt / session_start|end / memo activity
Does not treat the two timesheet sources as interchangeable
